🎬 The Senior (2025)

The Senior tells the inspiring true story of Mike Flynt, a former college football player who gets an extraordinary opportunity to return to the sport decades after his playing career came to an unexpected end. Nearly forty years after being dismissed from his college football team, Mike discovers that he still has one season of eligibility remaining and decides to pursue a dream that most people would consider impossible. At 59 years old, he returns to Sul Ross State University in Texas, determined to prove that age does not have to define a person’s ambitions. However, competing against athletes young enough to be his children brings enormous physical challenges, demanding training sessions, and skepticism from those who question his decision. As Mike struggles to regain his strength, earn the respect of his teammates, and prove himself on the field, he must also confront the personal mistakes and regrets that have followed him throughout his life. Meanwhile, his determination to finish what he started creates emotional challenges for his family, forcing him to reconsider the meaning of success and redemption. Through difficult practices, inspiring moments, and unexpected friendships, Mike discovers that the greatest victories are not always measured by the scoreboard. Combining heartfelt drama, emotional performances, and uplifting sports storytelling, The Senior explores perseverance, family, second chances, forgiveness, personal growth, and the courage to chase a dream regardless of age.

🎭 Genre: Sports • Drama • Biography
